'''2000 Tierfon Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Tierfon region (Belgium) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00tierfon">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=tierfon 2000 Regionals: Tierfon], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010728170600/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=tierfon Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Maarten Logghe]] of Leuven, Belgium won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 24 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Forbidden Zone Rue des Tamines 25 Brussels, Belgium
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Joeri Hoste]]
